selection: Per fit/model minimum fixed global Known validation k2 SB-hRMSE; 13 candidate epochs; no train+validation refit.
scope: Target-only participant downsampling, other drug data fixed; coadministered connected drugs jointly reduced. Existing Known validation/test fixed. Repeated-use benchmark, not independent confirmation.

head_definitions.no_molecule: Zero molecular input, no chemistry relation
head_definitions.drug_id: Train-defined identity embedding, no chemistry; mean train embedding UNK fallback
head_definitions.molecular_offset: Molecular prior plus bounded drug-specific 5-parameter offset; unseen offset exactly zero
head_definitions.scale_rate: Molecular context outputs log Vc and four kinetic rates. No independent output amplitude; same five PK degrees of freedom.

calibration: Fit population only on each reduced training partition, three starts x120steps; shared across five conditions.
future_joint: Preserve existing Joint results separately. No claim of new-head Joint validation in this low-data experiment; later nested fold-specific selection required.
model_training: Original support with random k 0/1/2/4, hierarchical weighted future MSE + .001 parameter penalty + .0001 prior deviation penalty; no relation signals for fair chemistry controls.
baseline_loss: Same weighted future log MSE, random support k; native head/dynamics. No MHAP-specific offset or observer penalties on external models.

baseline_scope.deepct: Pinned 13-parameter DeepCt head with ledger extension and support log-scale personalization. Not native end-to-end reproduction.
baseline_scope.unipk: Pinned Uni-PK NeuralODE with algebraically equivalent cached context, rtol1e-5 atol1e-7, ledger extension, support log-scale personalization. Not native observation-conditioned workflow.
baseline_scope.dcm: Deterministic compartment prior with support log-scale personalization; not ME-DCM.

unavailable.neural_ode_lu: Existing runner subclasses Uni-PK, not Lu. Excluded pending actual task integration.
unavailable.me_dcm: Random-effects VI implementation of cited ME-DCM absent.

failure_policy: Preserve failed fit and logs; no zero/worst scores, no unregistered post-test tuning; report complete paired coverage separately.
